tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search approved maxand98 articles and projects. Returns stable resource URIs and short excerpts.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read an approved article or project as clean Markdown.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Return the citation for a maxand98 publication or its complete bibliography in CSL-JSON, BibTeX, or RIS.

tools.name: get_claim
tools.description: Return one evidence-backed claim from The Punks Are Permanent, including its article references and source relationships.

tools.name: trace_evidence
tools.description: Follow a preservation claim to its definitive bibliography records and primary or supporting sources.

tools.name: simulate_failure
tools.description: Model what survives, degrades, or becomes unavailable when parts of the current CryptoPunks presentation stack fail.
